column3: Goldfish as a Model for Understanding Learning and Memory
column4: In summary, this data suggests that goldfish have a spatial memory of at least six months.

column3: How many senses do we have? 22-33 senses?
column4: Many of us learned that humans have just five senses. But modern neuroscience tells us that we actually have between 22 and 33 senses.
